test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

apple has also introduced a (rule that seemed tie) to its recent dispute with Basecamp.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**rule that seems tied**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence contains an error in tense and agreement.
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so the verb "**seemed**" is incorrect
